title: Bands in Alexandria; news of Dad and T-boy
summary: Few players in Alexandria; the group learns that Dad and bassist T-boy have died.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Well, who was up in Alexandria? They have any bands up there?
They got a few fellas out there with them so they can't play. Jerry Williams and...
You come with John Tonkin, Dad?
Yeah. Jerry Williams and I don't know him. It's a bunch of noise they got up there in England and they do nothing.
Well, Dad told me he stayed up there a long time.
Yeah, T-boy. Yeah. T-boy dead? Yeah. The bass player? The bass player.
Yeah, I believe he's dead. I believe that's what Dad told me.
Little Dad passed on too. He hadn't been dead. Yeah, I didn't know about that.
He stayed up there a long time.
That was quiet about that. I didn't know anything about that. Well, it happened, I think, on a Friday or something and his niece couldn't get in touch
